title: The Queue — EN/ZH/ES (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar trilingual storytelling 104bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan vocal English Mandarin Spanish language learning patient absurdist comedy
lyrics:
[Intro - piano, patient and steady]
There are people who are good at queuing
And there are people who are not
This man was genuinely excellent at it

[Verse 1 - English]
He arrived early, positioned correctly
Maintained the appropriate distance from the person in front
Did not look at his phone
Arrived at the front in seventeen minutes
The person behind the counter looked up and said
Can I help you
And he opened his mouth
He had nothing to buy
He had queued out of habit
He bought a small bottle of water he did not need
It cost two dollars and forty cents
He had the exact change

[Verse 2 - 中文 Zhōngwén]
他很早就到了，站好了位置
(He arrived early and positioned himself correctly)
与前面的人保持适当的距离
(Maintained the appropriate distance from the person in front)
没有看手机
(Did not look at his phone)
十七分钟后到达前面
(Arrived at the front in seventeen minutes)
柜台后面的人抬起头说
(The person behind the counter looked up and said)
我能帮助您吗
(Can I help you)
他没有什么要买的
(He had nothing to buy)
他是出于习惯而排队
(He had queued out of habit)

[Chorus - Español]
No tenía nada que comprar
(He had nothing to buy)
No tenía absolutamente nada que comprar
(He had absolutely nothing to buy)
Había hecho cola por costumbre, se dio cuenta
(He had queued out of habit, he realised)
Era muy bueno en la cola
(He was very good at queuing)
No había pensado en la compra
(He had not considered the buying)
Compró una botella pequeña de agua
(He bought a small bottle of water)
Dos dólares cuarenta
(Two dollars forty)
Tenía el cambio exacto
(He had the exact change)

[Bridge - all three]
He still has the receipt for the water
他还保留着水的收据
Todavía tiene el recibo del agua
He filed it under W — 他把它归档在W下面 — Lo archivó bajo la W
Behind the warranty for the filing cabinet
在文件柜的保修卡后面
Detrás de la garantía del archivador

[Outro]
He queues less now — 他现在排队少了 — Ahora hace menos cola
But when he does — 但当他排队时 — Pero cuando lo hace
He brings a list — 他带着一张清单 — Lleva una lista
Usually bread — 通常是面包 — Generalmente pan
